title: NOT Pfaltzgraff original !!!
text: NOT Pfaltzgraff original !!!. I ordered two sets of these mugs from the seller "Shops 24Seven" and upon arrival they came (well packaged) from WALMART !  They are not marked as being Pfaltzgraff.  They say "China" on the bottom.  I tested one in the microwave as most mugs from China get very hot.  The cups were very warm to the touch but the handle was not.  Overall, nice big mugs, but they are NOT Pfaltzgraff originals !!!
